OriginalEnglish: A mysterious maze said to change its form depending on the adventurers who enter it.

The den of a deadly demon whose heart has been blackened by baleful magics.
The home of a master of monsterkind who delved too deep into the secrets of the dark arts.

The spiteful seat from which the Dragonlord prepared his plans to rule the world.
Ruins ruled by nefarious knights who sold their souls for power, and lie in wait to waylay any who dare disturb them.
A battlefield blighted by a huge monster who knows neither mercy nor manners.
The secret base of a band of bandits who wear nothing but briefs and hoods.

The mountain home of a fuzzy but furious bundle of fur.
A stadium in which await some of the strongest monsters of legend.
An arid arena ruled over by a king driven mad by a cursed sword.
The throne room of the psychopathic sovereigns of Accordia.
The lair of a dark and ancient evil reborn after many long years.
The setting for the demon lord's sickening transformation into his terrible true self.
